degree_mode.screen_notes: Mode screen row 1 reads DEG RAD GRAD; the highlighted one is active (DEG is the default). A DEG/RAD/GRAD indicator also shows at the top of the Home screen. Press clear or 2nd quit to go back.

sci_notation.screen_notes: Enter a number like 6.02 EE 23. Display format: mode, then move to row 2 and pick NORM / SCI / ENG, enter, clear. Result then shows in that format.
sci_notation.source_loc: p.7 (Modes: NORM SCI ENG; note that EE is the shortcut key for scientific notation)

quadratic_direct.screen_notes: 2nd poly-solv opens a menu (1: ax2+bx+c=0, 2: cubic). enter picks 1. Type a (screen shows a=), DOWN, b, DOWN, c (screen shows SOLVE at bottom right), enter, enter shows x1=; DOWN shows x2=. Negative numbers use the (-) key. Guide example 1,-2,2 gives x1=1+1i, x2=1-1i. For 165, -2.712, -0.0334 the guide shows no screen, so the two real roots are not shown by the guide (hand-checked: 0.024643 and -0.008213).
unverified_parts: numeric roots for 165/-2.712/-0.0334 not shown in guide

keys: [move to unknown on the SOLVE line with arrows]
numeric_solve.screen_notes: 2nd num-solv asks for the equation (max 40 characters): type the left side, enter, type the right side, enter. A variable-values screen lists every letter in the equation; fill the knowns with DOWN between them; a SOLVE: line picks the unknown (guide example: SOLVE: x>b, then enter). The answer screen shows the variable and a Left-Right line (how far the two sides are apart at the answer; near 0 is good). Letters come from the x y z t / a b c d key (press repeatedly). Guide says: if variables are already stored the solver uses those values. Errors "No sign change Change guess" / "Max Iterations Change guess" show a guess matters. The guide NEVER says that the unknown's value is the starting guess, and shows NO lower/upper bound prompt -> seed mechanism and bounds are UNVERIFIED. Cluck wording: "type a guess first if it asks".
unverified_parts: exact arrow count to choose the unknown

keys: x y z t a b c d (press until the letter shows)
store_recall.screen_notes: Store: 15 sto-> x y z t a b c d (press that key until x shows), enter; screen shows 15->x. Recall: 2nd recall, pick the variable, enter (value goes into your entry); or press the x y z t a b c d key to insert the name. 8 variables: x y z t a b c d. Ans: press 2nd answer (key shown as [answer] in the guide), or start with an operator and ans is put in front. Clear all variables: 2nd clear var, 1:Yes.
store_recall.source_loc: p.33-34 (Memory and stored variables); p.11 (Last answer)

ans_chain.screen_notes: Last entry result is stored in ans. Pressing an operator key first (+, -, x ...) puts ans in front automatically.

constants.screen_notes: NAMES/UNITS menus list 20 constants: c, g, h, NA, R, me, mp, mn, mmu, G, F, a0, re, k, e, u, atm, eps0, mu0, Cc. Screen shows 1: c Speed Light, 2: g GravityAccel, 3: h Planck Const, so g is item 2 (menu numbers beyond the first 3 are not shown by the guide; scroll with UP/DOWN). g = 9.80665 m/s2, G = 6.6743e-11, R = 8.314462618, k = 1.380649e-23, NA = 6.02214076e23. NO Stefan-Boltzmann sigma in this list.
unverified_parts: menu index numbers other than c=1,g=2,h=3

conversions.screen_notes: Menu: 1 English-Metric, 2 Temperature, 3 Speed and Length, 4 Pressure, 5 Power and Energy. Temperature list: F>C, C>F, C>K, K>C (guide shows the list, not item numbers).

reset.screen_notes: Resets to default settings; clears memory variables, history, ans, stats, stored operation. Guide prints "2nd reset 2" (the "2" answers the confirm prompt; the prompt screen is not shown). Variables only: 2nd clear var, 1.

history_edit.screen_notes: Re-edit a previous equation / history scroll on this model. (UNVERIFIED: no official source retrieved; keys left empty)
history_edit.source_loc: p.9-10 (Scrolling expressions and history) not read

degree_mode.screen_notes: Row 1 of the mode screen: DEG RAD GRAD; highlighted is active (DEG default). DEG/RAD/GRAD indicator shows at top of the screen.
degree_mode.source_loc: Getting Started p.2 (Modes) and indicator table p.1-2

sci_notation.screen_notes: Press the x10^n key to type a number in scientific notation, e.g. 6.02 x10^n 23; guide says use parentheses for correct order of operations. Display format: mode, row 2 NORM SCI ENG.
sci_notation.source_loc: Math Functions p.15 (x10^n Key); Getting Started p.2-3 (Modes)

quadratic_direct.screen_notes: No polynomial solver on this model.
quadratic_direct.fallback: Store a, b, c then type the quadratic formula once with the letters (see numeric_solve fallback).

keys: x y z t a b c (5 presses = a)
numeric_solve.screen_notes: NO equation solver. Fallback = "store a, b, c, then type the quadratic formula once": store each coefficient (value, sto->, x y z t / a b c key pressed until the letter shows, enter), then type (-b + sqrt(b^2 - 4ac)) / (2a) using the letters, enter; for the other root change + to -. The pieces (sto->, variable key cycling x y z t a b c, 2nd recall, sqrt key, (-) key) are each shown in the guide, but this combined sequence is NOT shown in the guide, so it is composed by us and unverified on-device. It is the slower route; say so.
numeric_solve.source_loc: Getting Started p.10-11 (Memory and Stored Variables)

keys: x y z t a b c (press until letter shows)
store_recall.screen_notes: Store: 15 sto-> then x y z t / a b c key, enter; screen shows 15->x then 15. Recall: 2nd recall, pick the variable, enter. 7 variables x y z t a b c. Ans: 2nd answer (guide heading "Last Answer"); key label inside the guide is a picture so the word is from the heading. Clear variables: 2nd clear var, 1.

constants.screen_notes: No built-in physics constants. The "Constant" feature (K) repeats an operation, it is not g or G.

conversions.screen_notes: No unit or temperature conversion menu (Conversions only switch fraction/decimal forms).
conversions.source_loc: Math Functions p.13 (order of operations list: Conversions n/d, F<>D, DMS)

reset.screen_notes: Resets unit to defaults; clears memory variables, history, stats, constant (K) and Ans. Variables only: 2nd clear var, 1.
reset.source_loc: Getting Started p.10 (top of page); p.9 Clearing

degree_mode.screen_notes: SHIFT MODE (SETUP) shows the setup menu; 3 = Deg (4 Rad, 5 Gra). Initial default is Deg. Initialize: SHIFT 9 (CLR) 3 (All) = (Yes).
degree_mode.source_loc: Configuring the Calculator Setup > Specifying the Default Angle Unit

sci_notation.screen_notes: Display: SHIFT MODE 7 (Sci) then 0-9 significant digits; back to normal: SHIFT MODE 8 (Norm) then 1 or 2. ENTRY key (x10^x) is NOT shown on the pages I retrieved: UNVERIFIED, press the key printed x10^x.

quadratic_direct.screen_notes: MODE 5 (EQN), 3 (aX2+bX+c=0), type each coefficient then =, negative uses (-); then = shows X1; each = shows next solution; DOWN/UP scroll; AC returns to the editor. Manual example 2x2+x-3=0 uses 2 = 1 = (-) 3 =. Screens for 165/-2.712/-0.0334 not shown in manual.

keys: [type equation with ALPHA letters, ALPHA CALC for =]
numeric_solve.screen_notes: Type the equation (X is ALPHA then the ) key; = sign is ALPHA CALC; an expression with no = is treated as =0). SHIFT CALC (SOLVE) asks "Y?" style prompts for each variable (type value, =), then "Solve for X" with the current value of X: type your starting value and press =. Result screen shows the equation, X= value, and L-R= (near 0 = good). Newton method: only ONE root is returned and a starting value closer to the root may be needed; if it gives up it shows "Continue: [=]". Use linear input while in SOLVE. SOLVE works in COMP mode only. Exit: AC.
numeric_solve.source_loc: Using SOLVE (manual example: y=ax2+b, X=1.414213562, L-R=0)

store_recall.screen_notes: Store: value then SHIFT RCL (STO) then the letter key: A=(-), B=DMS key, X=ALPHA then ")" key, M=M+ key. Recall: RCL letter, or ALPHA letter inside an expression. Ans key puts the last answer in. Replay: after a result, LEFT or RIGHT lets you edit the last expression. Clear all memories: SHIFT 9 (CLR) 2 (Memory) =.
store_recall.source_loc: Using Memory Functions (Variables A B C D E F M X Y); calculation_history.html (Replay)

ans_chain.screen_notes: Press an operator first and Ans is placed automatically, or press the Ans key.

constants.screen_notes: SHIFT 7 (CONST) then two digits: g=35, G=39, sigma=31, k=25, R=27, NA=24, c=28 (C0), h=06, e=23, eps0=32, mu0=33. 40 constants, CODATA 2014.

conversions.screen_notes: SHIFT 8 (CONV) then two digits: 37 = F>C, 38 = C>F (also 01 in>cm ... 40 cal>J).

reset.screen_notes: SHIFT 9 (CLR), 3 (All), = (Yes): returns mode and setup to defaults AND clears memory. Memory only: SHIFT 9 2 =.

sci_notation.screen_notes: Display Sci: SHIFT MODE 7 then 0-9; Norm: SHIFT MODE 8 then 1/2. x10^x entry key: UNVERIFIED (not on retrieved pages).

quadratic_direct.screen_notes: No EQN mode (manual lists COMP, STAT, TABLE only: no Equation Calculations section).
quadratic_direct.fallback: Store A, B, C and type the quadratic formula once.

store_recall.screen_notes: Same as fx-115ES PLUS: SHIFT RCL (STO) then A=(-) key, M=M+ key; recall with RCL letter; Ans key. Clear memories: SHIFT 9 2 =.

constants.screen_notes: No CONST menu in this manual.

conversions.screen_notes: No CONV menu in this manual.

degree_mode.screen_notes: Press HOME, open the Calculate app (OK), press SETTINGS (sliders icon), then Calc Settings > Angle Unit: Degree (default), Radian, Gradian. The top bar shows a D / R / G indicator.

sci_notation.screen_notes: Number Format: Fix, Sci, Norm 1, Norm 2. Entry key for x10^x not read: UNVERIFIED. Engineer Symbol setting is separate.

quadratic_direct.screen_notes: Coefficients are entered with EXE after each; negative uses SHIFT then the (-) legend key. EXE shows the first solution; DOWN (or EXE) shows the next solution then the minimum/maximum point. AC returns to the editor. Manual example x2+2x-2=0.

numeric_solve.screen_notes: Solver (in the Equation app). Store knowns first: VARS key, RIGHT, value, EXE (manual stores B=4). Type the equation (x key, x2 key, = is SHIFT + the ( key legend, unknown is x), EXE registers it, Solve Target screen: confirm [x] and OK, then type initial value of x and EXE, make sure [Execute] is selected and EXE. Result shows the variable, its value and (Left Side)-(Right Side) (closer to 0 = better). Only ONE root is returned (Newton method); change the initial value to get another or if it fails; a Continue/Exit screen can appear. Unknown must be a letter A-F, x, y or z (no "d").

store_recall.screen_notes: Press the variables key (shows A B C D E F x y z), choose [A=] > [Store] to save the last result; recall: that key, [A=] > [Recall], EXE. Typing a letter inside an expression: SHIFT then the number key printed with the letter (SHIFT 4 = A, SHIFT 5 = B), x has its own key. Ans key chains.
store_recall.source_loc: Variables (A, B, C, D, E, F, x, y, z)
